notes: minionx is Xiaomi-Robotics-1-RoboCasa365 fine-tuned with multi-teacher on-policy distillation (OPD); all weights were trained, inference code is unchanged from the Xiaomi release. training_config gives the final OPD stage only (batch 256, 800 steps); the steps used to train the teacher models are not included. Evaluated on RoboCasa 1.0.1, split=pretrain, 50 tasks x 50 official seeds: 1553/2497 successes (atomic_seen 728/900, composite_seen 464/800, composite_unseen 361/797). Technical report (arXiv) planned by 2026-10-26. Private access to the checkpoint and the evaluation code will be granted to @sepnasiriany for verification.
